subcategory_text: Data processing ecosystem parties (e.g., service providers, customers, partners, product manufacturers, application developers) are identified, prioritized, and assessed using a privacy risk assessment process.
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: SR-6 (Supplier Assessments and Reviews)
ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A.5.19, A.5.20 (Addressing information security within supplier agreements)
GDPR Art. 28 (Processor obligations), Art. 35 (DPIA when processing on behalf)
Aligned with NIST CSF 2.0 GV.SC-04 (suppliers identified and prioritised) and ID.SC-02 (suppliers prioritised)
implementation_examples: Identify and document third parties involved in processing personal data (service providers, customers, partners, product manufacturers, application developers)
Prioritise these parties by virtue of the sensitivity of the data they handle and the criticality of the service they provide
Apply a privacy-risk assessment process to each prioritised party and record the assessment outcome
assessment_objectives: Determine whether third parties in the data processing ecosystem are identified
Determine whether parties are prioritised by sensitivity and criticality
Determine whether a privacy-risk assessment process is applied to prioritised parties
Determine whether assessment outcomes are recorded and tracked
